infoLinks.urlText: Sydney Olympic Park bus diversions for Robbie Williams concert
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 14 November
  • From 1am on Saturday 14 November to 1am on Sunday 15 November, route 526 services will be diverting while roads are closed in Sydney Olympic Park for the Robbie Williams concert at Accor Stadium on Saturday 14 November.  
  • Services in both directions will be diverting via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and a stop on Park Street. 
  • Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations. Visit the Robbie Williams event page for more details.  
 
Closed stops 
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue after Edwin Flack Avenue (212787)  
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue before Edwin Flack Avenue (212788) 
  • Park Street opposite Olympic Park Station (212790)  
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue opposite Olympic Park Station (212791) 
  • Olympic Park Station, Dawn Fraser Avenue (212792)

infoLinks.urlText: Major Event Buses operating for the Robbie Williams concert at Sydney Olympic Park
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 14 November
  • From 3pm Saturday 14 November to 12am Sunday 15 November Sydney Olympic Park Major Event Buses will run for the Robbie Williams concert at Accor Stadium.
  • Travel on Major Event Buses is included in the cost of your event ticket. Attendees do not need to tap on and off, simply show your match ticket to the driver when boarding buses.
  • Buses run frequently. Visit the Robbie Williams event page for more details.
